page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-192-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-dense server instance. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor with 96 physical cores and 192 vCPUs using the x86_64 architecture. The CPU operates at a base speed of 2.3 GHz and features a 504 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 1488.0 GB of RAM, yielding 7.75 GB of memory per core. Local storage consists of 32 NVMe SSDs totaling 12599 GB of capacity. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

In benchmark testing, the server demonstrates top-tier multi-core processing capabilities, placing in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and PassMark CPU scores. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, with both small-block and large-block read-only tests scoring in the top 10%. Database operations and Redis SET operations also rank in the top 10%, reflecting the high-throughput capabilities of the bundled NVMe storage. However, single-core CPU performance on stress-ng falls into the middle 50%, indicating a tradeoff where performance is optimized for parallelized workloads rather than single-threaded execution speed.

The hardware profile and benchmark results suggest this server is suited for memory-intensive and high-throughput database workloads, such as large-scale Redis deployments, database operations, and multi-threaded data decompression. It also performs well in software compilation and ray tracing. For LLM inference, the server achieves top-tier prompt processing speeds for large models, though text generation speeds remain in the average tier. From a qualitative cost efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated CPU cores, massive memory capacity, and integrated local NVMe storage provide a consolidated resource footprint that reduces the need for external storage attachments.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-192-lssd is a memory-optimized and storage-dense server powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 192 vCPUs (96 physical cores) operating at 2.3 GHz, 1488.0 GB of RAM, and 12599 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 32 drives. Benchmark data shows top-tier multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations, though single-core performance remains in the average tier. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel AMX for accelerated matrix operations. This server is designed for highly parallelized, memory-intensive workloads such as large-scale databases, Redis deployments, and multi-threaded data processing. The integration of massive local storage and high memory density provides a consolidated, high-throughput resource profile for demanding enterprise applications.
